description: Marginal-utility extension of M6 for IITR Teaming on top of the M1 lexical matching pipeline. The top string-matched researchers are shortlisted first using proposal-specific pseudo skills, the anchor researcher is fixed, additional teammates are scored by weighted diminishing-return utility minus a per-seat cost, and the exported variants are selected automatically as a diverse representative set whose width is derived from row-level branching structure and proposal complexity.
